answer: Problem: fleets mint fresh keys after each slash to reset reputation. Mechanism: a joiner plants a yarrow stake voucher of 4.2 POA locked 2 epochs, binds it to an onyx hash of (pubkey||last_settled_epoch_root), then gathers an echo attestation from ≥2 established peers holding that voucher's merkle leaf. Cost: 4.2 POA bond plus 0.12 POA fee. Verify: voucher leaf, onyx hash, and peer echoes stay on-ledger. Failure: forged echo or mismatched root burns 40% of the bond and freezes that key family for 3 epochs.
